page.layout: One printed page. Top: dedication title block, centred (headings and lines). Below: running text in one column with a woodcut initial. Show-through text from the reverse page is faint in the background and is not transcribed. No margin notes.

main_text.l: A quo tempore Studijs, quæ mo-
Instituto primario juvando atque exornando satis

page.notes: The woodcut initial is an "A" with foliate ornament. The Greek word "Πολυμάθεια" is printed in Greek letters. The asterisk mark after "exornando" is a catchword-area ornament; the word "satis" at the foot is treated as the catchword. Faint show-through of the reverse page is present throughout and was omitted.
